mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the rank correlation coefficient between FEDFUNDS change and 20-day returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.3pp in a month, or the rank correlation between UNRATE change and 5-day returns is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% from the prior month indicate a contraction in private demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% in a month, or the rank correlation between the joint decline and 60-day returns is below -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals a manufacturing supply shock, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines by >0.2% in a month, or the rank correlation between INDPRO decline and 20-day returns is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPI inflation exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as central banks may tighten policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by >0.5pp in a month, or the rank correlation between CPIAUCSL change and 5-day returns is above -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in the labor force (PAYEMS) over the prior quarter indicates improving economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through increased consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS expands over the prior quarter, or the rank correlation between PAYEMS change and 60-day returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: The positive return signal from residential housing expansion is active only during the residential housing expansion regime (HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month), producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising construction activity and associated economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when the residential housing expansion regime is active (HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month), or the rank correlation between the regime and 20-day returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior quarter indicates a severe supply-demand shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 decline > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline by >0.3% in a quarter, or the rank correlation between the joint decline and 5-day returns is above -0.05.
